posts.text: When the goal is deploying #nuclear power at scale, fuel readiness matters. That’s why we designed the Gravity™ Nuclear Reactor around commercially available Low Enriched Uranium (LEU)—the same type of fuel that has powered pressurized water reactors for generations. @DeepFission, building around an established fuel ecosystem spanning enrichment, fabrication, transportation, reactor operations and regulation is a deliberate part of our deployment-first approach. Our CEO and co-founder @eamuller explains the thinking behind that decision. Read her latest article ⬇️ https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/fuel-thats-ready-wins-elizabeth-liz-muller-s3bxc/
